description: Le Vésinet, 20 minutes from Paris by car and 24 minutes by metro (7 minutes from the station + 16 minutes to Charles de Gaulle Etoile RER A, Champs Elysées). House with garden of 700 m2, tennis table and piano. 3 bedrooms for 6 people + 1 independent studio for 2 people, 3 bathrooms, TV room, dining room, kitchen, laundery. Very close to Croissy lake and to the grocery stores, in a peaceful environment. Very easy to park several cars.
